target.title: fix: keep emoji intact at remaining text truncation boundaries
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Five user-visible text truncation sites still use bare `.slice(0, N)` which counts UTF-16 code units and can split surrogate pairs at the boundary:

| File | Line | Context |
|:---|:---:|:---|
| `restart.ts` | 282 | `normalizeRestartIntentReason` — restart reason text |
| `restart.ts` | 847 | `triggerOpenClawRestart` — restart reason text |
| `chat-composer.ts` | 2219 | Reply target text preview |
| `chat-thread.ts` | 434 | Thread text preview |
| `chat-thread.ts` | 534 | Message text extraction |

These were missed by earlier sweeps (#101685, #101711, #101728).

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace `.slice(0, N)` with `truncateUtf16Safe(text, N)` from `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice`. All three files use the same canonical import path already established by prior fixes in the same packages.

## User Impact

Restart reason text, reply previews, and thread message previews will no longer display `�` when an emoji falls near the character boundary.

## Evidence

**Regression test:** `restart.test.ts` — 7 passed

```
pnpm test -- src/infra/restart.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  7 passed (7)
```

**UI test:** Chat component tests pass (failures are pre-existing locale/microphone issues):

```
pnpm test -- ui/src/pages/chat/components/
Test Files  6 failed | 136 passed (142)  ← 6 pre-existing failures
     Tests  9 failed | 2292 passed (2301)
```

**What was not tested:** Full UI rendering of emoji boundary truncation in chat-composer and chat-thread (requires browser automation). The `truncateUtf16Safe` primitive is already covered.

AI-assisted.
